releases.body:
## What's new

- Pace indicators per window: `+Npp` reserve, `on pace`, and `-Npp` deficit, with fixed-width columns so label, bar, percentage, pace and countdown stay aligned. The monthly row is labelled `1mo` and its pace follows the subscription anniversary (one UTC calendar month, 28 to 31 days).
- Any non-zero usage fills at least one bar cell, so 2% and 4% no longer look uncoloured.

## Fixes

- Credential resolution falls back from `opencode-go` to the OpenCode Console (`opencode`) credential in the database and `auth.json`. Legacy rows with a NULL `active` column count as active, and a 401 moves to the next candidate. An OAuth `access` token is used unless its numeric expiry is already past.
- The environment key is resolved first, and the credential stores are only read when another attempt is needed.
- The sidebar keeps usage state, the refresh cycle and the countdown across panel remounts, and drops late results after cleanup.
- A single unreadable credential row no longer discards the credentials collected before it.

## Maintenance

- CI now typechecks `tests/` and runs the Bun test suite: 89 tests.

## What's Changed
* Fix sidebar panel stuck in loading state by @saihgupr in https://github.com/PentSec/opencode-go-usage-meter/pull/1
* build: typecheck CI and pin plugin range by @PentSec in https://github.com/PentSec/opencode-go-usage-meter/pull/2
* fix(tui): bound the refresh cycle and stop overlapping polls by @PentSec in https://github.com/PentSec/opencode-go-usage-meter/pull/3
